x: A pleasing feature of this event was that all our runners who had competed here before (five) improved upon their previous best time; some by considerable margins. Placings and times :- 6, C.N.
Colin Collis, making a very successful comeback, was our first man home. He was closely followed by Eric Gebbett and Archie Bedford who both ran well in very difficult conditions.

With such a fast winning time many meritorious performances "down the field" are apt to be overlooked, but Colin Collis deserves special mention for his 11th place in 1h.50m.50s as does Bob Plummer for his best ever time of 1h.52m.54s.
